translations.web: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.
translations.bsb: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
translations.kjv: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.
translations.asv: And the two companies of you, even all that go forth on the sabbath, shall keep the watch of the house of Jehovah about the king.
